title: Feature registry
summary: The machine-checked master list of every feature, and the generator of the index pages
intro: Register a feature with tools\feature-registry.ps1 add, regenerate the pages with tools\build-feature-pages.ps1, and let the battery guard name what is missing. Needs PowerShell 7.3 and a repository clone.
